title: radionetwork
description: adds radio in your minecraft world
body:
🎧 RadioNetwork brings real-world radio straight into Minecraft.
Designed for Forge 1.20.2, this mod lets you listen to live radio stations like Sky Radio, NPO Radio 1, NPO Radio 2, and Radio 538 while you play. Build, explore, or survive with nonstop music, news, and hits playing directly in your world.

Whether you want relaxing background music, live news, or high-energy chart hits, RadioNetwork connects Minecraft to real radio—making your world feel more alive than ever.

🔥 Features

keys (k) to open the menu
Live radio streaming inside Minecraft

Includes Sky Radio, NPO Radio 1 & 2, and Radio 538

Perfect for building, survival, and roleplay

Lightweight and easy to use

Built for Forge 1.20.2

🎶 No playlists. No loops. Just real radio.
With RadioNetwork, your Minecraft world stays connected.
